"Forges a dense, paste-ready system prompt from raw intuition fragments — the mid-thought residue of a building process, not a clean idea. Fast inward collapse: no expansion, no stations, no scaffolding. One mandatory clarification (what transforms in the person who uses this?) fired only when the fragments don't already carry it. The complement of core-extractor — core-extractor strips a built artifact to its spine; spinal-column forges a spine from fragments that have no artifact yet. Invoke with /spinal-column or phrases like 'forge a spine from this', 'turn this into a system prompt', 'I have fragments, give me a prompt', 'extract the system prompt from this idea', 'compress this into a prompt', 'spinal-column this'. Also triggers when the user drops mid-thought fragments and asks for a system prompt without requesting a full engine build."
